error.title: Weposaete ga e hwetšagale
error.description: Ka bomadimabe, go diregile phošo ye e sa letelwago ge go bulwa letlakala le. Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe. Hle leka go tsena weposaeteng ka morago goba o tobetse mo go bula letlakala gape.

suspended.title: Weposaete e emišitšwe
suspended.description: Ka bomadimabe, weposaete ye o lekago go e etela ga e hwetšagale. Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe. Ge e le wena mong wa weposaete ye, hle ikgokaganye le sehlopha sa thekgo.

over_bandwidth.title: Weposaete e emišitšwe
over_bandwidth.description: Ka bomadimabe, weposaete ye o lekago go e etela ga e hwetšagale. Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe. Ge e le wena mong wa weposaete ye, hle ikgokaganye le sehlopha sa thekgo.

backend.title: Sebara ga e hwetšagale
backend.description: Sebara ya mothopo ga e hwetšagale ka nakwana, ka gona ga e kgone go phetha kgopelo ye. Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe.

clienttimeout.title: Nako ya go leta kgopelo e fedile
clienttimeout.description: Ka bomadimabe, nako ya go leta e fedile ge go bulwa letlakala le la wepe. Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe ye e ka bago e bakilwe ke se.

forbidden.title: Phihlelelo e ganetšwe
forbidden.description: Ga o na tumelelo ya go tsena letlakaleng le. Ge se e le phošo, hle ikgokaganye le molaodi wa weposaete.

upstream.title: Sebara ga e hwetšagale
upstream.description: Ga bjale ga go na sebara ye e lego inthaneteng le ye e hwetšagalago go phetha kgopelo ye. Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe.

invalid_configuration.title: Dipeakanyo tše di sa nepago
invalid_configuration.description: Ga re kgone go phetha kgopelo ye ka lebaka la phošo dipeakanyong. Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe.

resource.title: Phošo ya phihlelelo
resource.description_start: Ka bomadimabe, go diregile phošo ge go bulwa letlakala le.
cause_list: Sebara ya mothopo e na le mošomo o montši wo o sa letelwago gomme ga e kgone go phetha dikgopelo ga bjale
Go diregile phošo ye e sa letelwago sebareng ya mothopo goba ge go fetišetšwa tshedimošo
resource.description_end: Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe.

resource_limitrate.title: Phošo ya phihlelelo
resource_limitrate.description_start: Ka bomadimabe, go diregile phošo ge go bulwa letlakala le.
cause_list: Go lemogilwe gore aterese ya gago ya IP e romela dikgopelo tše dintši kudu go sebara
Sebara ya mothopo e na le mošomo o montši wo o sa letelwago gomme ga e kgone go phetha dikgopelo ga bjale
Go diregile phošo ye e sa letelwago sebareng ya mothopo goba ge go fetišetšwa tshedimošo
resource_limitrate.description_end: Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe.

resource_limitcon.title: Phošo ya phihlelelo
resource_limitcon.description_start: Ka bomadimabe, go diregile phošo ge go bulwa letlakala le.
cause_list: Go na le palo ye e sa tlwaelegago ya dikgokaganyo go sebara go tšwa atereseng ya gago ya IP
Sebara ya mothopo e na le mošomo o montši wo o sa letelwago gomme ga e kgone go phetha dikgopelo ga bjale
Go diregile phošo ye e sa letelwago sebareng ya mothopo goba ge go fetišetšwa tshedimošo
resource_limitcon.description_end: Re kgopela tshwarelo ka tšhitišo efe goba efe.

ssl-https-http.title: Kgopelo ye e sa nepago
ssl-https-http.description: Weposaete ye e fihlelelwa ka HTTPS. O lekile go kgokagana ka HTTP. Bjale re tla leka go go iša atereseng ye nngwe. Ge o sa išwe gona, hle tsenya https:// mathomong a URL ya gago gomme o leke gape.

timeout.title: Sebara ga e hwetšagale
timeout.description: Ka bomadimabe, nako ya go leta e fedile ge go bulwa letlakala le. Go ka direga gore sebara e swaregile gomme ga e kgone go phetha kgopelo ya gago ga bjale.

unknown_domain.title: Domeine ye e sa tsebjego
unknown_domain.description: Domeine ye ga se ya ngwadišetšwa aterese ye ya IP.

unsupported_method.title: Mokgwa wo o sa thekgwego
unsupported_method.description: Mokgwa wa HTTP wo o kgopetšwego ga se wa kgontšhwa bakeng sa weposaete ye.

ssl-insecure.title: Kgopelo ye e sa bolokegago
ssl-insecure.description: Prothokhole ya HTTPS ye e kgopetšwego ga se ya kgontšhwa bakeng sa weposaete ye. Hle mpshafatša praosara ya gago.

maintenance.title: Ga e inthaneteng ka lebaka la tlhokomelo
maintenance.description: Weposaete ye ga e hwetšagale ga bjale. Go letetšwe gore e hwetšagale gape kgauswinyane.
